sections.heading: Scope
paragraphs: This policy covers the Lightly photo editor and lightly.pro. Privacy enquiries can be sent to hello@lightly.pro.

sections.heading: Editing on your device
paragraphs: Lightly processes the photographs you choose on your device. The app does not upload them to Lightly, require a Lightly account, or include advertising or analytics. Save copy creates a new image; Share opens the system share sheet so you choose the destination. The receiving app has its own privacy practices.

sections.heading: Photos and permissions
paragraphs: You choose photos through the system picker or use the camera. Lightly requests permissions needed for those actions and for saving. You can manage permissions in your device settings. On Android, access to a chosen photo may be retained to restore an editing session.

sections.heading: Faces, subjects and depth
paragraphs: Available Portrait and Background tools analyse faces, features, subject outlines and depth locally to apply edits. They do not identify who a person is. These results are not sent to us and may be retained locally with an unfinished edit so it can be restored.

sections.heading: Metadata and location
paragraphs: Keep photo metadata and Include location are separate controls. Camera and exposure details can be kept while location is excluded. Location is off by default and can only be included when available in the photo supplied by your device. These preferences apply to saved and shared copies.

sections.heading: Local storage
paragraphs: Preferences, favourite presets, signatures, logos and temporary editing data are stored on your device.

While you edit a photo, Lightly keeps recovery data on your device so the edit can be restored if the system closes the app. On iPhone and iPad it contains a copy of the photo, the edit history and the masks or depth computed for it; it is kept only while the edit has unsaved changes and is deleted when you save a copy, discard the edit, close the photo or open another one. On Android it contains a copy of the photo, the edit history and any areas filled by Remove; it is deleted when you discard the edit, leave the editor or open another photo, and the next time Lightly starts without an edit to restore, for example after you remove the app from your recent apps. Recovery data is excluded from device backups and device-to-device transfers.
Removing the app removes everything it stored, but not exported photos or copies you shared elsewhere.

sections.heading: Visiting this website
paragraphs: This site uses Cloudflare for hosting and delivery. Requests necessarily expose technical information such as your IP address, requested URL and browser information to the hosting service. Cloudflare may process it for delivery, security and operations. See Cloudflare’s privacy policy.

We have not added advertising, analytics scripts, embedded third-party media or tracking cookies to this site. Fonts and images are hosted with the website. Hosting-level security features may have their own technical requirements.

sections.heading: Contacting us
paragraphs: If you email us, we receive your email address and whatever you send, including attachments. We use this to respond and investigate your request. Do not send private photos unless necessary and agreed. The email provider also processes correspondence.

sections.heading: Your choices and changes
paragraphs: You can manage local app permissions and stored content through the app and device. For information about correspondence you have sent us, or to request its correction or deletion, email hello@lightly.pro. Applicable legal rights depend on your location. We will update this page when our practices change.

sections.heading: About Lightly
paragraphs: Lightly is a photo-editing app for iOS and Android. This website describes the product and provides support information. For questions about these terms, contact hello@lightly.pro.

sections.heading: Your photographs
paragraphs: Your photos and edits remain yours. Lightly claims no ownership of them. You are responsible for having the permissions needed to edit and share content, including images of other people. Do not use the app or website for unlawful activity or to infringe another person’s rights.

sections.heading: Using the app
paragraphs: Use the app in accordance with applicable law and the terms supplied with its release. Do not disrupt the website or attempt to access systems without permission. Any restrictions are subject to rights that applicable law gives you.

sections.heading: Results and originals
paragraphs: Automated and image-processing tools can make mistakes. Review the result before sharing it. Save copy is designed to preserve the original, but you should maintain your own backups of important photographs.

sections.heading: Availability and purchases
paragraphs: No purchase or subscription is offered on this website. Store purchases are also subject to the relevant store’s payment and refund terms and applicable consumer law.

sections.heading: Website and third-party materials
paragraphs: The Lightly name, logo and website materials are provided to describe the product. Third-party photographs and fonts retain their respective ownership and licence terms. Nothing here restricts rights granted by an open-source licence.

sections.heading: Consumer rights
paragraphs: Nothing in these terms is intended to exclude rights that cannot lawfully be excluded, including applicable consumer rights.

sections.heading: Contact
paragraphs: For questions about Lightly or these terms, email hello@lightly.pro.
